description: This Java class defines a specific error type, DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError, which extends Error to indicate that a deserialization strategy could not be found for a given entity class. It includes constructors to create instances with the relevant class and optional cause, and formats an error message.

classes.name: DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError
classes.description: An error class for reporting the fact that for a particular type a deserialization strategy could not be found.

methods.description: Constructor that creates a new DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError with the specified entity class and no cause.
